challenges.name: fix-stock-reservation-rollback
challenges.title: Fix the stock reservation that keeps half an order
challenges.description: Hồ Gươm Books reserves stock for every line of an order, all or nothing. A rejected order kept the copies it had reserved before the failing line, and an order with a deleted book threw an exception that stopped the whole night batch. Fix placeOrder: release what the order reserved when a line fails, reject orders for unknown books and bad quantities as well as for missing stock, and let every other error through. The test runner reads the stock and the orders and prints the result of every order and the stock left.

tests.name: Orders that fit are reserved
tests.input:
stock truyen-kieu 5
stock so-do 3
stock clean-code 2
order HG-1 truyen-kieu:2 so-do:1
order HG-2 clean-code:2
tests.expected:
HG-1: ok
HG-2: ok
stock truyen-kieu: 3
stock so-do: 2
stock clean-code: 0

tests.name: A rejected order releases the lines it reserved (the incident)
tests.input:
stock truyen-kieu 5
stock so-do 3
stock clean-code 2
order HG-1 truyen-kieu:2 so-do:5
order HG-2 truyen-kieu:5
tests.expected:
HG-1: rejected: only 3 left of so-do
HG-2: ok
stock truyen-kieu: 0
stock so-do: 3
stock clean-code: 2

tests.name: An unknown book rejects the order and the batch goes on
tests.input:
stock truyen-kieu 5
stock so-do 3
stock clean-code 2
order HG-1 clean-code:1 nha-gia-kim:1
order HG-2 clean-code:2
tests.expected:
HG-1: rejected: unknown book nha-gia-kim
HG-2: ok
stock truyen-kieu: 5
stock so-do: 3
stock clean-code: 0

tests.name: A quantity of 0 is rejected after two reserved lines
tests.input:

stock so-do 3
stock clean-code 2
order HG-7 so-do:1 truyen-kieu:2 clean-code:0
order HG-8 so-do:3 truyen-kieu:5

HG-8: ok
stock truyen-kieu: 0
stock so-do: 0
stock clean-code: 2

tests.input:

HG-10: ok

stock so-do: 0
stock clean-code: 2

tests.name: A long night batch

stock clean-code 2
stock sapiens 1
order N-1 sapiens:1
order N-2 sapiens:1 so-do:1

N-4: ok
